```{r setup, include=FALSE}
## Global options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache = T)

library(INLA)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(nowcaster)
library(truncnorm)
library(scoringRules)
library(scoringutils)

source("functions_multivar_nowcasting.R")
```

## Dados
```{r}
max_t <- 200
D <- 15
y <- matrix(NA, max_t + D, D)


alpha_1 <- 1
alpha_2 <- 0.5
beta    <- matrix(nrow = max_t, ncol = 2)
gamma_d <- matrix(nrow = D + 1, ncol = 2)
delta   <- vector(length = max_t)
psi     <- vector(length = D + 1)
x <- vector(length = max_t)
beta_x <- vector(length = max_t)


set.seed(123)


beta[1, ] <- rnorm(2)
gamma_d[1,] <- rnorm(2, mean = 1.5)
delta[1] <- rnorm(1)
psi[1] <- rnorm(1)
x[1] <- rnorm(1)
beta_x[1] <- rnorm(1)


tau_time <- 100
tau_time1 <- 50
tau_delay <- 100
tau_delay1 <- 50
tau_beta_x <- 0.5
tau_x <- 100

# phi1 <- 0.4
# phi52 <- 0.3

# Geração dos efeitos/covariaveis
for(t in 2:max_t){
  # Efeitos do tempo (por doença e conjunto)
  beta[t, ] <- rnorm(2, mean = beta[t-1, ], sd = sqrt(1/tau_time))
  delta[t] <- rnorm(1, mean = delta[t-1], sd = sqrt(1/tau_time1))
  
  # Regressora e efeito da regressora
  x[t] <- x[t-1] + rnorm(1, sd = sqrt(1/tau_x))
  beta_x[t] <- beta_x[t-1] + rnorm(1, sd = sqrt(1/tau_beta_x))
  
  # if(t <= 52){
  #   X[t] <- phi1*X[t-1] + rnorm(1, 0, sqrt(1/tau_param))
  # }else{
  #   X[t] <- phi1*(X[t-1]) + phi52*(X[t-52])  + rnorm(1, 0, sqrt(.25))
  # }
}

for(d in 2:(D + 1)){
  # gamma_d[d, ] <- rtruncnorm(n = 1, mean = gamma_d[d-1, ], sd = sqrt(1/tau_delay),
  #                            a = -Inf, b = gamma_d[d-1, ])

  psi[d] <- rtruncnorm(n = 1, mean = psi[d - 1], sd = sqrt(1/tau_delay1),
                       a = -Inf, b = psi[d - 1])
  
  gamma_d[d, ] <- rnorm(n = 2, mean = gamma_d[d-1, ],
                               sd = sqrt(1/tau_delay)) #,
                             #a = -Inf, b = gamma_d[d-1, ])
  # 
  # psi[d] <- rnorm(n = 1, mean = psi[d - 1], sd = sqrt(1/tau_delay1))
  
}

ts.plot(beta)
ts.plot(gamma_d)
ts.plot(delta)
ts.plot(psi)
ts.plot(x)
ts.plot(beta_x)
```


```{r}
input1 <- cbind(rep(alpha_1, max_t*(D+1)), 
                rep(gamma_d[,1], max_t),
                rep(beta[,1], each = D+1), 
                rep(delta, each = D+1),
                rep(psi, max_t),
                rep(beta_x*x, each = D+1))

input2 <- cbind(rep(alpha_2, max_t*(D+1)), 
                rep(gamma_d[,2], max_t),
                rep(beta[,2], each = D+1), 
                rep(delta, each = D+1),
                rep(psi, max_t),
                rep(beta_x*x, each = D+1))

LP1 <- rowSums(input1)
LP2 <- rowSums(input2)
```

```{r}
# x = x/10
```

```{r}
y <- cbind(rnbinom(n = (D+1)*max_t, size = 3, mu = exp(LP1)),
           rnbinom(n = (D+1)*max_t, size = 3, mu = exp(LP2)))

cor(LP1, LP2)
cor(y)

colnames(y) <- c("y1", "y2")


y_df <- cbind.data.frame(y, 
                         time = rep(1:max_t, each = D+1), 
                         delay = rep(0:D, max_t)) %>% 
  mutate(report_time = time + delay)

y_df %>% 
  group_by(time) %>% 
  summarise(y1 = sum(y1),
            y2 = sum(y2)) %>% 
  select(-time) %>%
  ts.plot()



y_new <- y_df %>% 
  mutate(y1_obs = ifelse(report_time > max_t, NA, y1),
         y2_obs = ifelse(report_time > max_t, NA, y2))

```


## Modelo 

```{r}
n <- nrow(y)
y_bvar <- matrix(NA, nrow = 2 * n, ncol = 2)
y_bvar[1:n, 1] <- y_new$y1_obs
y_bvar[n + 1:n, 2] <- y_new$y2_obs

I <- matrix(NA, nrow = 2 * n, ncol = 2)
I[1:n, 1] <- 1
I[n + 1:n, 2] <- 1


fixed_covariate = data.frame(alphai = as.factor(c(rep(1, n), rep(2, n))),
                             id_time1 = c(rep(1,n), rep(NA, n)),
                             id_delay1 = c(rep(1,n), rep(NA, n)),
                             id_time2 = c(rep(NA, n), rep(1, n)),
                             id_delay2 = c(rep(NA, n), rep(1, n)),
                             idrep = rep(1:2, each = n),
                             id_x = c(y_df$time, y_df$time),
                             id_x1 = c(y_df$time, rep(NA,n)),
                             id_x2 = c(rep(NA,n), y_df$time)) #rep(NA,n)))


random_covariate <- list(time1  = c(y_df$time, rep(NA, n)),
                         delay1 = c(y_df$delay, rep(NA, n)),
                         time2  = c(rep(NA, n), y_df$time),
                         delay2 = c(rep(NA, n), y_df$delay),
                         time = rep(y_df$time, 2),
                         delay = rep(y_df$delay, 2),
                         x = rep(x, each = D + 1))




Y = y_bvar
joint_data <- cbind(Y, fixed_covariate, random_covariate)


half_normal_sd =function(sigma){
  return(
    paste("expression:
              sigma = ",sigma,";
              precision = exp(log_precision);
              logdens = -0.5*log(2*pi*sigma^2)-1.5*log_precision-1/(2*precision*sigma^2);
              log_jacobian = log_precision;
              return(logdens+log_jacobian);",sep='')
  )
} 

# Modelo considerando dois efeitos diferentes para a covariável.
joint_model <- Y ~ -1 + alphai +
  + f(time,  model = "rw1", replicate = idrep,
      hyper = list("theta" = list(prior = "loggamma"))) +
  + f(delay, model = "rw1", replicate = idrep,
      hyper = list("theta" = list(prior = "loggamma"))) +
  + f(time1, model = "rw1",
      hyper = list("theta" = list(prior = "loggamma"))) +
  + f(time2, copy  = "time1", fixed = TRUE,
      hyper = list("theta" = list(prior = "loggamma"))) +
  + f(delay1, model = "rw1",
      hyper = list("theta" = list(prior = "loggamma"))) +
  + f(delay2, copy  = "delay1", fixed = TRUE,
      hyper = list("theta" = list(prior = "loggamma"))) +
+ x +
# + f(id_x, x, model = "rw1", replicate = idrep,
#     hyper = list(prec = list(param = c(0.001, 0.001))), initial = 0) 
+ f(id_x1, x, model = "rw1",
    hyper = list(prec = list(param = c(0.001, 0.001))), initial = 0) +
+ f(id_x2, x, copy = "id_x1", fixed = T)
  

teste_regressora <- INLA::inla(joint_model, family = rep("nbinomial", 2),
                      data = joint_data,
                      control.predictor = list(link = 1, compute = T),
                      control.compute = list( config = T, waic=T, dic=T),
                      control.family = list(
                        list(hyper = list("theta" = list(prior = "loggamma", param = c(0.001, 0.001)))),
                        list(hyper = list("theta" = list(prior = "loggamma", param = c(0.001, 0.001))))
                      ),
                      verbose = F
                      
)

summary(teste_regressora)

modelo_uni <- Y ~ -1 + alphai +
  + f(time,  model = "rw1", replicate = idrep,
      hyper = list("theta" = list(prior = "loggamma"))) +
  + f(delay, model = "rw1", replicate = idrep,
      hyper = list("theta" = list(prior = "loggamma"))) +
+ x +
+ f(id_x, x, model = "rw1", replicate = idrep,
    hyper = list(prec = list(param = c(0.001, 0.001))), initial = 0) 
# + f(id_x1, x, model = "rw1",
#     hyper = list(prec = list(param = c(0.001, 0.001))), initial = 0) +
# + f(id_x2, x, copy = "id_x1", fixed = T)

teste_uni <- INLA::inla(modelo_uni, family = rep("nbinomial", 2),
                      data = joint_data,
                      control.predictor = list(link = 1, compute = T),
                      control.compute = list( config = T, waic=T, dic=T),
                      control.family = list(
                        list(hyper = list("theta" = list(prior = "loggamma", param = c(0.001, 0.001)))),
                        list(hyper = list("theta" = list(prior = "loggamma", param = c(0.001, 0.001))))
                      ),
                      verbose = F
                      
)

#x11()


```

```{r}
scores_biv <- scores_posterior(pred_samples, dados_by_week)
scores_uni <- scores_posterior(pred_uni, dados_by_week)
```


```{r}
energy_score <- scores_biv$energy_score
variogram_score <- scores_biv$variogram_score

energy_score_uni <- scores_uni$energy_score
variogram_score_uni <- scores_uni$variogram_score


ts.plot(energy_score, main = "Energy score")

```

```{r}

mape_df <- data.frame(time = numeric(), mape_sum = numeric())
for(i in 1:D){
  dat_bi <- pred_samples |> filter(time == 185 + i) %>% .[,c(3,4)]
  dat_uni <- pred_uni |> filter(time == 185 + i) %>% .[,c(3,4)]
  real <- dados_by_week |> filter(time == 185 + i)
  
  mape_bi <- abs((dat_bi$Y1 - real$y1)/real$y1) + 
    abs((dat_bi$Y2 - real$y2)/real$y2)
  
  mape_uni <- abs((dat_uni$Y1 - real$y1)/real$y1) + 
    abs((dat_uni$Y2 - real$y2)/real$y2)
  
  mape_df <- rbind(mape_df, 
                   cbind.data.frame("time" = 185 + i, 
                                    "mape_sum" = c(mape_bi, mape_uni), 
                                    "Model" = c("Bivariate", "Univariate")))

  
    
}

mape_df <- mape_df |> mutate(Model = factor(Model, 
                                            levels = c("Univariate",
                                                       "Bivariate")))

library(ggridges)

ggplot(mape_df, aes(x = mape_sum, y = factor(time), fill = Model)) +
  geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.4, rel_min_height = 0.01, bandwidth = 0.03) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0,2)) +
  labs(y = "Time", x = "Distribution of the absolute percentage error") +
  theme_minimal()

```
